name: Sophia
description: A compact Sophia optimizer factory. foreach, fused, and capturable execution are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.Sophia when available; otherwise supported Sophia options

papers.title: Sophia: A Scalable Stochastic Second-order Optimizer for Language Model Pre-training

examples.title: Optimize a quadratic objective
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.sophia import sophia

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0))
optimizer = sophia([parameter], lr=0.05)
optimizer.zero_grad()
(parameter - 1).square().backward()
optimizer.step()
